reducing-ozone-depletion-timeline.alt: A timeline from 1970 to 2070. 1974: scientists warn that CFCs could destroy stratospheric ozone. 1985: the ozone hole over Antarctica is reported. 1987: the Montreal Protocol is signed. 1996: CFC production ends in developed countries. 2010: CFC production ends worldwide. 2016: the Kigali Amendment adds a phase-down of HFCs. About 2066, shaded as a projection: Antarctic ozone is expected to be back to 1980 levels.
